notes.title: PEDAL TO THE METAL! BURNIN' RUBBER 6 REVEALED, LAUNCHING 2025
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881750

Xform Games is proud to announce the new installment of their flagship franchise.

[b]Burnin' Rubber 6[/b] brings the action with a variety of modes, from open-world exploration to intense sprint and circuit races. Battle relentless, aggressive AI opponents who will stop at nothing to stay ahead. Wield your arsenal of weapons to obliterate everything in your path. Sharpen your skills to compete once more in the Tournament of Champions!

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Single Player Campaign: Start your adventure and enjoy hours of racing action!
[*] 6 Open Worlds: Explore and take on special free-roaming challenges!
[*] 60+ Tracks: Replay the classics, try new ones, or create your own!
[*] Level Editor: Want to jump through a massive stack of red barrels? Let's do it!
[*] 50+ Vehicles: We've got them all! Street racers, muscle cars, heavies, and fan favorites!
[*] Collect and Unlock Skins: Customize your collection of cars!
[*] 30+ Unique Weapons: Master powerful new weapons to annihilate your enemies!
[*] Split-Screen Mode: Have a blast crushing your friends in explosive split-screen battles!
[*] (Mini)Boss Battles: Push your skills to the limit in epic boss encounters.
[*] Face off against another epic Xform End Boss in a thrilling showdown!
[/list]

The game is set to release for PC on Steam in 2025. 
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881750/Burnin_Rubber_6/]Wishlist now![/url][/h3]

- Xform Games

notes.title: Burnin' Rubber 5 HD 1.0.4 now live!
notes.content:
-----------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.4 February 
-----------------------------------------------------
* fixed special weapons not showing up after selecting a boss vehicle
* fixed inferno wheels odd texturing
* fixed timer on bossbattles - player timer and boss timer start simultaneously (leaderboards 0 scores removed)
* fixed issue where main vehicle was not 'found' when selecting/changing team vehicles - resulting in additional vehicles in garage
* fixed issue where menu would dissapear and you couldn't continue to the garaqe
* fixed issue with vehicles withouth weapons looking for targets to fight
* fixed localization issue in pause screen for team vs challenges
* created a location to place the main vehicle in garage instead of on track - thus no vehicle on track anymore when test driving a team vehicle
* daily challenges now go directly to challengeselect after pressing next in the results panel
* implemented maximum duration of 10 secs for counting large amounts of XP in results screen
* updated proxy of scud so it can drive under bars in Shipyard
* changed load type for music to avoid hiccup on challenge start
* some minor tweaks and fixes
* one new hidden vehicle

notes.title: Burnin' Rubber 5 HD 1.0.2 is now live
notes.content:
-----------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.2 Release Notes
-----------------------------------------------------
* fixed issue where VSync (and framerate limit) were incorrectly set after restarting
* fixed incorrect Dare Devil achievement tracking.
* fixed incorrect count of prestige
* fixed issues with incorrect placement of teammembers, incorrect textures or camera positions 
* fixed issue where being destroyed after finishing would hide the results screen forever
* fixed Steam achievements not being send - VISIT THE INGAME ACHIEVEMENTS PANEL TO RETRIEVE THEM
* fixed resetting the boss timer on retrying a boss challenge
* fixed issue where boss vehicles would incorrectly trigger the destruction shot
* fixed issue where hidden vehicles could unlock themselves (not intended)
* fixed issue with incorrect colored scenery objects
* adjusted the proxy of the Tumble for better driving against walls
* laserturret now does proper damage as in the original one
* leaderboards activated and visible in Steam Community Hub
* esc no longer returns to Garage in pause screen
* updated icon to high res version (Steam)
* build includes basic support for forcing textures to a lower resolution to get more performance where possible
  - See forum for more details
* build includes support for Direct3D9 and OpenGL 
  - this is usefull if you have a very old GPU and are experiencing a purple/pink hue. 
  - See forum for more details
* 2 new hidden vehicles
